products.name: The Prompt Engineering OS
products.description:
Most developers treat prompting like it's guesswork. They copy examples from Reddit, tweak wording until something works, and never understand why. Then the model updates and everything breaks again.


It doesn't have to be that way. Prompting has structure. It has patterns that fail and patterns that reliably succeed. This guide documents all of them.


30 chapters across 8 parts:


Part I: Foundations — The mental models that separate consistent results from lucky guesses.

Part II: The Technique Hierarchy — 8 techniques ranked by impact, with examples that work in production.

Part III: The System Layer — System prompt architecture, the 8 Template Schemas, CLAUDE.md engineering, progressive disclosure.

Part IV: The Psychology of Prompting — The 7 Persuasion Principles for AI and how to avoid sycophancy traps.

Part V: Agentic Patterns — Multi-agent orchestration, subagent design, skill architecture, self-correction loops.

Part VI: The 8 Development Patterns — Iron Law, Reconnaissance, Progressive Fallback, and five others.

Part VII: The Deadly Seven Anti-Patterns — The most common mistakes with specific fixes.

Part VIII: Applied Domains — Software engineering, content, image generation, business and strategy.


Who this is for:

  • Developers building with Claude, GPT-4, or Gemini
  • - AI engineers designing multi-agent systems
  • - Technical founders using LLMs in production
  • - Power users who use AI daily

What makes this different:

  • Systems, not tricks. You'll understand why techniques work.
  • - Every pattern is from production use, not academic benchmarks.
  • - The agentic section goes where most guides stop.
  • - Honest about what doesn't work.

30 chapters. 100+ templates. 125 code examples. 22 reference tables.


Synthesized from Anthropic's official documentation, 434 YouTube videos, academic research, and 18 months of production deployment.


No risk. If it doesn't change how you prompt within a week, email me for a full refund.
